---
name: link-audit
description: Audit Ventura Algorithms references for canonical destinations duplicates and stale educational links. Use when maintaining or releasing the curated algorithms index. Do not use when evaluating the correctness or complexity of an algorithm entry itself.

# Link audit

- Check links in changed algorithm sections.
- Prefer canonical documentation textbooks project pages or stable educational references.
- Detect duplicate destinations and redundant resources.
- Flag dead moved or clearly obsolete references.
- Preserve historical resources only when their role is explicit.
- Recheck Markdown formatting after edits.
